transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this production lock roundtable to order. As we finalize the presentation plan for The Last Orchard at the Calder Cinema on October 18, I need to ask our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes before I can approve the final plan. Could you both walk us through where things stand?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed change on the rights front. I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning. It permits exactly one public screening — not two. It requires 35mm projection, not a digital cinema package. It prohibits any audience or house recording entirely. And it requires the credit line to read 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate,' not our standard courtesy credit. I have not yet uploaded the email to the shared production packet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a confirmed change on the music front. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated, and I haven't yet added it to the shared call sheet. The agreement requires a 14-player ensemble — not the 10-player ensemble in the draft plan. Additionally, the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18 — not the 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM slot in the draft. Both of these need to be reflected in the final presentation plan before it's approved.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Upload the revised license email from the Orchard Estate to the shared production packet.
Add the signed musicians' agreement to the shared call sheet.
